blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines —Kayla Sanchez was scratched from the women’s 100-meter backstroke in the Asian Games swimming on Wednesday, taking a did-not-start (DNS) as the Philippine team prioritizes her recovery ahead of the 50m freestyle. National coach Ryan Arabejo said the team wanted to give Sanchez the best possible preparation for a gold medal bid. “Let’s focus on what we can control. If we can rest Kayla and prepare her better for tomorrow’s 50-meter event, where she has a very good chance of winning gold, then we decided to give […]...
